summary: "Should Investors Buy Visa Instead of Mastercard? | V Stock vs. MA Stock" by Parkevtate Vosianc CFA, published 2026-09-25, is a head-to-head comparison of the payment duopoly, published about 15 minutes before the scan. He would pick Visa today — it has better margins (67% vs 59%) and mild undervaluation — while owning both as long-term compounders. No stance flips (no prior V/MA calls on record).
